exercises: a pointer whose token contains a slash, escaped as ~1 per RFC 6901

expected.assert: listRecentlyReturnedBooks shows a 200 with the description 'Matching books.' and an array-of-Book body.
The pointer token `~1books` is unescaped to `/books` before the lookup. Splitting the pointer on `/` without unescaping first would look for a path named `~1books` and find nothing.
A pointer may target any node, not only a components bucket. Resolution must be a generic pointer walk, not a set of per-bucket prefix matches.
